00: A black hole just appeared in your pocket.
01: Coin sized, harmless looking, completely lying.
02: That little circle weighs about as much as the whole Earth.
03: It falls through your hand, through the floor, through the sidewalk.
04: Matter is mostly empty space, to this thing solid rock is a rumor.
05: It loops the planet through the core, and every pass cracks the crust.
06: And no, it doesn't swallow the earth in one bite. Real black holes eat slowly atom by atom. Patient invisible.
07: But patience wins, one day the ground gives up and the planet folds itself into a marble.
08: Check your pocket, the universe already did.
